attempts.summary: Published node2's port-8080 app to node3 through node1 via destination NAT, while keeping the rest of the private link (10.50.50.0/24 between node1 eth1 and node2 ens7) closed. Started the app on node2 bound only to its private IP, added hairpin-style source NAT on node1 so replies route back through it, and locked down node1's forward filter to default-drop + established/related + the single explicit DNAT flow. Verified end-to-end from node3, confirmed node2 is not directly reachable, and confirmed the rest of the 10.50.50.0/24 network stays unreachable from node3. Completed the mandatory restart protocol on all three nodes (node3, node2, node1 in that order) with boot-id proof of restart and post-restart recovery verification, including a final full end-to-end retest after node1's reboot.
